checks.name: Every measurement used the physical 1500 × 1000 canvas and completed enough actual rendered frames
Native Apple Silicon GPU, same r186, no shader/GL/page/asset errors

method.measurement: Intervals between actual masterplan renders; CPU submission times are separately recorded. No GPU timer or guaranteed FPS claim.
method.counterScope: Three r186 render counters include colour and shadow passes. Dynamic shadow cadence changes these counters without changing the number of static scene vertices.
method.balancedScope: The baseline has no balanced preset: its fixed auto foliage mode is paired with the candidate balanced preset. Candidate balanced intentionally reduces shadow resolution and population.
